scope: Hosted Core contract runner disk reclamation and failure diagnostics before and after full-history archive-heavy shards.

edits.current:
# The full-history evidence checkout needs about 18 GB; hosted runners start
      # with roughly 20 GB free, and archive-copying tests then exhaust the disk.
      - name: Free hosted runner disk for the evidence checkout
        run: |
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          df -h /

- name: Report disk after the evidence checkout
        run: df -h / "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

- name: Report disk and memory after the shard
        if: always()
        run: |
          df -h / "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          free -m

, source.replace("/opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL", "/opt/hostedtoolcache")
		, source.replace('df -h / "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"', "true")
		, source.replace("Report disk and memory after the shard\n        if: always()"
			, "Report disk and memory after the shard\n        if: success()")
